Generate Synthetic Two-Domain Spiral Data

Source: R/kema-validation.R
generate_spiral_validation_data.Rd

Creates the synthetic spiral dataset used in KEMA paper Figure 2 for numerical validation.

Usage

generate_spiral_validation_data(
  n_per_domain = 100,
  noise_level = 0.1,
  seed = 42
)

Arguments

n_per_domain

Number of samples per domain

noise_level

Gaussian noise standard deviation

seed

Random seed for reproducibility

Value

List with domain data and labels

Examples

data <- generate_spiral_validation_data(n_per_domain = 50, seed = 123)
str(data)
